body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q2FY25 call (2024-11-08), prompted: "So my strategy for Mexico to answer the first question, no margin erosion over there. First stage, hardly any capex" Metric: Mexico capex and margin. Target: Phase 1 near-zero capex; group margin not diluted. Deadline: 2026-12-31 (vague). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: Phase 1 was a warehouse only; no large Mexico capex disclosed; group OPM rose to 21-24%. Phase 2 (local production) not yet started. Management-only evidence.
